cards.title: Act Like You Belong
cards.instruction: You do not understand what is happening. Copy the confidence around you and never admit confusion.

cards.title: Change What the Apology Is For
cards.instruction: Get an apology, then reveal that the original offense was only the first layer of what needs repair.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I accept your apology for missing my concert. I bowed when the conductor bent down; you would have liked the finish.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: He was picking up his baton. You bowed to your music stand.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Exactly, acknowledging everyone. Now apologize for leaving me to do that without one friendly face watching.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'm sorry. I watched the recording last night, straight after the concert.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then say you're sorry for keeping that to yourself. I spent all evening thinking nobody I knew had seen the end.

reason: Make the copied bending unambiguously a mistaken bow, and state the recording was watched during the relevant evening so A's deeper grievance follows actual known timing.
